thread:
Alia: FYI — pricing slab update for EU commits goes live Mon 2026-04-06. This changes slab thresholds and discount sequencing for Reserved/Commit deals. Need to flag active POCs that should be grandfathered. ping @DealDesk
DealDesk Bot: Automated: pricing_slab_v3 published to internal docs. /docs/pricing/slab_v3
Tom S: @Alia can you paste the high-level delta? quick call with Acme POC tomorrow.
Alia: High level: slabs move from [0-100k,100k-500k,500k-1M,1M+] -> [0-50k,50k-250k,250k-750k,750k+]. Max auto discount reduced ~2pp on mid slabs. Grandfathering: LOIs signed before cutoff keep prior slab for initial commit term. Need list of active LOIs in EU.
Maria G: We have 3 EU POCs >$30k: Acme (Sarah), HealthRx, FinTrust. Acme LOI signed 2026-03-28. HealthRx verbal only. FinTrust still evaluating.
Jess (Product): Acme wants a 90-day POC with dedicated capacity. Likely to request exception to old pricing. @DealDesk what’s the quick checklist?
DealDesk Bot: Checklist: 1) LOI copy, 2) estimated commit tokens, 3) approver(s) (Sales Ops + Eng), 4) security checkbox, 5) legal sign-off. Use template: /templates/exception_request
Kyle: On security — HealthRx has outstanding SCC Qs about data residency. Is this slab change tied to infra or region changes? they could push back.
Alia: Nope, no infra changes. Purely pricing logic. Messaging should explicitly state no residency/SLA changes.
Tom S: I'll DM Sarah at Acme. If LOI is pre-cutoff, can we auto-apply prior slab? Who signs off on that?
DealDesk Bot: Policy excerpt: "Pre-cutoff LOIs (signed) automatically maintain original slab through initial commit term; requires Sales Ops audit."
Maria G: I'll gather LOIs and upload to the shared drive. Sharing: https://drive.internal/r/poceuis/Acme_HealthRx_FinTrust (private)
Jess (Product): :thumbsup: Please include token profile (monthly QPS + expected long-seq distribution). I’ll run a quick cost delta.
Kyle: If Acme asks an extra 5% discount due to enterprise motion, do we have margin to absorb?
DealDesk Bot: Reminder: Any >3pp deviation from list pricing requires VP approval. Route requests via #deal-desk-approvals.
Alia: Action items: Maria collect LOIs by EOD Friday. Tom follow up with Acme. Jess run cost delta. Kyle prep margin caveats. I’ll draft the comms for Sales.
Tom S: Quick Q — does this affect existing committed accounts renewing next quarter?
Alia: Renewals are not retroactive. New commits after cutoff use new slabs. Renewals handled separately; I’ll loop in Renewals team.
Maria G: Uploading Acme LOI now.
DealDesk Bot: Upload detected: Acme_LOI_20260328.pdf by Maria G. Ticket created: DD-8942
Tom S: Excellent. I’ll confirm signature status with Sarah.
Jess (Product): Cost delta: if Acme stays on old slab they save ~$4.2k/mo. I’ll post the calc to the drive.
Kyle: Noted. If we need VP sign, give me a heads-up.
Alia: Thanks all — aim to finalize exceptions by EOD Monday.
